workNature.description: Textile designers create repeat patterns, design weaves and coordinate with mills for production.

name: Jewellery Design

whoShouldPursue: Those interested in gems and luxury

workNature.description: Jewellery designers sketch collections, create CAD models and coordinate with karigars for production.

faqs.answer: They design jewellery collections, create CAD models and work with karigars.

faqs.answer: Yes — Matrix/RhinoGold CAD skills are industry standard now.

faqs.answer: Film school (FTII) or assist directors while building a strong showreel.

name: Radio Jockey and Anchoring
title: Radio Jockey / Anchor
introduction: Radio Jockeys entertain thousands of listeners daily with music, chat and wit. Podcasts and digital audio have expanded this career beyond FM stations.
whoShouldPursue: Those who love music and entertainment

workNature.description: RJs host live shows, interview guests, read scripts naturally and build listener communities.
